title: Finite recoverability-first projected Petz transport
question: Can approximate Markovness of a low-energy projected Gibbs state be transported back to the original state with a dimension-free Petz triangle and contractivity budget, avoiding a dimension-growing entropy-continuity shortcut?

model.tripartition: A=core, B=buffer, C=environment, with omitted exterior traced out
model.projection: sigma=(P_A tensor I_BC) rho_ABC (P_A tensor I_BC) / Tr(P_A rho_A)
model.projected_recovery: R_sigma is the Petz map built from sigma_BC and sigma_B
model.analytic_target: replace generic entropy continuity by a dimension-safe recoverability transfer, then separately prove a uniform Gibbs moment and shell modulus

lean_crosscheck.boundary: Lean checks scalar triangle and contractivity arithmetic only; finite Petz matrices and all cutoff/QFT transfers remain Python/open analysis.

qft_interface.closed: On the finite declared grid, a single projected Petz map transports the recovery error with a dimension-free triangle budget, and the AB input displacement is contractive within numerical tolerance.
qft_interface.open: The transport budget is cutoff-sensitive; it is not a QCMI upper bound. Uniform Gibbs moments, dimension-safe QCMI continuity, projected-QCMI transfer, shell summability, common core, Cook/common-alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A and Pre-A remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary finite approximate-Markov interface only; no physical-sector conclusion or production-owner transfer is supplied.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite recoverability-first projected Petz transport only. It proves no QCMI upper bound, cutoff-independent moment or recovery modulus, Gibbs complement theorem, shell modulus, source/volume/shape bound, common core, beta/eta-independent topology, domain or Cook/common-alpha convergence, OS/KMS/GNS reconstruction, gap, continuum, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A result.
no_overclaim: A dimension-free finite recovery triangle avoids a generic log-dimension continuity factor, but it does not make the projected recovery error or the projection disturbance uniformly small and does not identify the Q3LOCK thermodynamic dynamics.
